title: tests/integration/prm-09-pack-update.test.zig uses unqualified solution_pack_installs — sqlstate 42703 (INC-001 from WF03-GH785-20260815 step-5)

incidental_of.context: Pre-existing test-code bug surfaced during TEST-RUNNER retry 6's optional targeted test runs on the GH-785 verification branch. NOT a GH-785 regression; out of scope for WF03-GH785-20260815.

scope: tests/integration/prm-09-pack-update.test.zig — qualifies `solution_pack_installs` without `public.` schema prefix; unresolved against per-tenant search_path lands on tenant_default.solution_pack_installs with mismatched columns.
description: All four TC-PRM-09-NN tests fail with sqlstate 42703 because the test file issues INSERT/SELECT against unqualified `solution_pack_installs`. After WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815 migration chain, the unqualified name resolves against the per-tenant search_path and lands on `tenant_default.solution_pack_installs` (introduced by migration 1158 with the `-- scope: tenant_only.` header), which has a column layout that does not match the test's parameter list. `public.solution_pack_installs` (introduced by migration 1157 also with `-- scope: tenant_only.` per the GH-785 fix) is the actually-intended destination — but the per-tenant search_path wins. Pre-existing, NOT a GH-785 regression; out of scope for WF03-GH785-20260815. To be picked up by its own WF-03 cycle.
symptom: zig build test-integration-prm-09 against BPM_TEST_DB_URL: 4/4 FAIL with `[42703] column X does not exist` against `tenant_default.solution_pack_installs`.
investigation_notes: GH-785 verification confirmed the PLC suite (27/27) is green — the failure surfaces only in the optional targeted PRM-09 run that TEST-RUNNER performed after passing the PLC suite. Direct psql reproduction confirms that `INSERT INTO solution_pack_installs` from a `SET search_path = tenant_default, public` session fails because the tenant-side table has different columns from the public-side table. The test was written against the public-side table. The fix is to qualify every reference to `solution_pack_installs` with `public.`. No production-code change required.
reproduction: BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test zig build test-integration-prm-09 -> 4/4 FAIL. Reading tests/reports/report-2026-08-15-WF03-GH785-20260815-step05-verify.yaml section INC-001 confirms the same root cause.
fix_line: TBD — qualifier every reference (find each INSERT/SELECT on solution_pack_installs and prefix with public.)
fix_diff: Replace `solution_pack_installs` with `public.solution_pack_installs` at every test reference. Verify test setup does not depend on tenant-side rows; if it does, qualify selects the same way and shape the setup inserts accordingly.

handoff_history.summary: Surface INC-001: TC-PRM-09-01..04 fail with sqlstate 42703 in the optional targeted prm-09 run on the GH-785 verification branch. Pre-existing test-code bug (unqualified solution_pack_installs resolving to tenant_default.solution_pack_installs via search_path). Does NOT block WF03-GH785-20260815 (full PLC suite is 27/27 green). Filed as ISS-0707 with GH #792 for separate WF-03 cycle resolution.
